name: GrixTrack
tagline: Rank tracking plus AI citation tracking for ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode.
description: GrixTrack is a rank tracker and AI citation tracker built by Grixhub in Bangkok. It tracks Google positions for your keywords by country, city and language, and checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode mention or cite your brand for the questions your customers ask. You can see which sources the AI answers cite, compare competitors, and send PDF or email reports to clients. Thai keywords and prompts are fully supported alongside English and any other language. Start on the free plan with no card; paid plans start at $17.99 a month for rank tracking and $22.99 for AI citation tracking.
